title: On the Price of Privacy for Language Identification and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.07238v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models train on sensitive user data, so we ask what differential privacy (DP) costs in language learning. We study private language identification and generation in the agnostic statistical setting. For identification, privacy is free: at every fixed $\varepsilon$, pure DP and $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP with $\delta\ge n^{-O(1)}$ keep the non-private rate $\exp(-r(n))$ for every $r(n)=o(n)$. For generation, the price depends on what is public. With a public witness bound, pure DP loses at most a factor $\Theta(\min\{1,\varepsilon\})$ in the exponent, and on suitable two-language collections the optimal rate is $\exp(-\Theta(\min\{1,\varepsilon\}\,n))$. Without such a bound, pure DP can lose the exponential rate itself, already for two languages: every rate $\exp(-o(n))$ stays achievable, but no exponential rate is. translated_title: 论语言识别与生成中隐私保护的代价
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在敏感的用户数据上进行训练，因此我们探讨差分隐私（DP）在语言学习中的代价。我们在不可知统计设置下研究隐私保护的语言识别与生成问题。对于识别任务，隐私是免费的：在每个固定的 ε 下，纯 DP 以及 δ ≥ n^{-O(1)} 的 (ε,δ)-DP 都能对任意 r(n)=o(n) 保持非隐私速率 exp(-r(n))。对于生成任务，代价取决于哪些信息是公开的。当存在公开的见证界时，纯 DP 在指数上至多损失因子 Θ(min{1,ε})，并且在适当的双语言集合上，最优速率为 exp(-Θ(min{1,ε}·n))。而当没有这样的界时，纯 DP 可能完全失去指数速率，即便仅有两种语言也是如此：所有 exp(-o(n)) 量级的速率仍然可达，但任何指数速率都不可达。在这些集合上，(ε,δ)-DP 能保持指数速率当且仅当 log(1/δ) 满足相应条件（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示了差分隐私在语言学习中的代价结构：语言识别中隐私几乎免费，而语言生成中代价取决于公开信息——有公开见证界时纯DP仅损失Θ(min{1,ε})的指数因子，无此界时纯DP则会彻底丧失指数收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the price of differential privacy in language learning: privacy is free for language identification, while for generation the cost hinges on public information—with a public witness bound, pure DP loses at most a factor Θ(min{1,ε}) in the exponent, but without it pure DP can lose the exponential rate entirely.
